Name: Total Vessels Previous Period
Expression:
VAR WeekFiltered = ISFILTERED('CALENDAR'[WEEK_OF_MONTH])
VAR MonthFiltered = ISFILTERED('CALENDAR'[MONTH_YEAR])

RETURN
IF(
    WeekFiltered || MonthFiltered,
    VAR FirstDateOfMonth =
        CALCULATE(
            MIN('CALENDAR'[Date]),
            FILTER(ALL('CALENDAR'), 'CALENDAR'[MONTH_YEAR] = MAX('CALENDAR'[MONTH_YEAR]))
        )
    VAR LastDayNum = DAY(EOMONTH(FirstDateOfMonth, 0))
    VAR Offset = WEEKDAY(FirstDateOfMonth, 2) - 1
    VAR SelectedWeekNo = IF(WeekFiltered, MAX('CALENDAR'[WEEK_OF_MONTH_NO]))

    VAR WeekStartDay = IF(WeekFiltered, MAX(1, 7*(SelectedWeekNo-1) - Offset + 1), 1)
    VAR WeekEndDay = IF(WeekFiltered, MIN(LastDayNum, 7*SelectedWeekNo - Offset), LastDayNum)

    VAR EffectiveMinDate = FirstDateOfMonth + WeekStartDay - 1
    VAR EffectiveMaxDate = FirstDateOfMonth + WeekEndDay - 1

    VAR DaysSpan = DATEDIFF(EffectiveMinDate, EffectiveMaxDate, DAY) + 1
    VAR PrevMaxDate = EffectiveMinDate - 1
    VAR PrevMinDate = PrevMaxDate - DaysSpan + 1
    RETURN
    CALCULATE(
        [Total Vessels],
        FILTER(
            ALL('CALENDAR'),
            'CALENDAR'[Date] >= PrevMinDate && 'CALENDAR'[Date] <= PrevMaxDate
        )
    ),

    -- Case 2: nothing selected -> unchanged from before
    VAR CurrentWeekVal =
        CALCULATE(MAX('CALENDAR'[WEEK_OF_MONTH]), FILTER(ALL('CALENDAR'), 'CALENDAR'[Date] = TODAY()))
    VAR CurrentMonthVal =
        CALCULATE(MAX('CALENDAR'[MONTH_YEAR]), FILTER(ALL('CALENDAR'), 'CALENDAR'[Date] = TODAY()))
    VAR CurrentWeekMinDate =
        CALCULATE(MIN('CALENDAR'[Date]), FILTER(ALL('CALENDAR'), 'CALENDAR'[WEEK_OF_MONTH] = CurrentWeekVal && 'CALENDAR'[MONTH_YEAR] = CurrentMonthVal))
    VAR PrevAnchorDate2 = CurrentWeekMinDate - 1
    VAR PrevWeekVal2 =
        CALCULATE(MAX('CALENDAR'[WEEK_OF_MONTH]), FILTER(ALL('CALENDAR'), 'CALENDAR'[Date] = PrevAnchorDate2))
    VAR PrevMonthVal2 =
        CALCULATE(MAX('CALENDAR'[MONTH_YEAR]), FILTER(ALL('CALENDAR'), 'CALENDAR'[Date] = PrevAnchorDate2))
    RETURN
    CALCULATE(
        [Total Vessels],
        FILTER(ALL('CALENDAR'), 'CALENDAR'[WEEK_OF_MONTH] = PrevWeekVal2 && 'CALENDAR'[MONTH_YEAR] = PrevMonthVal2)
    )
)

VAR PreviousMonthStart =
    EOMONTH ( CurrentDate, -2 ) + 1

        'CALENDAR'[Date] >= PreviousMonthStart
            && 'CALENDAR'[Date] <= PreviousMonthEnd
    )
)

Name: Highest Leakage Percentage
Expression:
VAR VendorTable =
    ADDCOLUMNS (
        ALLSELECTED ( Purchase_History[VENDORNAME] ),
        "@LeakageAmt", CALCULATE ( [Leakage Value] )
    )
VAR TopVendor =
    TOPN (
        1,
        FILTER (
            VendorTable,
            NOT ISBLANK ( [@LeakageAmt] ) && [@LeakageAmt] > 0
        ),
        [@LeakageAmt], DESC,
        Purchase_History[VENDORNAME], ASC
    )
